name: Grumman TBM Avenger
summary: WWII carrier-based torpedo bomber; the largest single-engine warbird type commonly seen at US airshows.

wings: Large, broad mid-mounted wing with squared tips
Wings fold back alongside the fuselage when parked
fuselage: Very deep, portly fuselage with a long greenhouse canopy for three crew
Ball turret at the rear of the canopy
tail: Large angular fin with a straight leading edge

tellTales: Huge single-engine radial airplane with a very deep, barrel-like fuselage
Long greenhouse canopy ending in a rear ball turret
Wings fold back along the fuselage when parked

confusedWith.howToTell: The Texan is a much smaller, slimmer two-seat trainer; the Avenger is huge with a deep belly and a rear ball turret.
The T-28 is a slim trainer on tricycle gear; the Avenger is a deep-bellied taildragger with a rear ball turret.
The Wildcat is a small single-seat fighter with a stubby body and narrow-track gear; the Avenger is a much bigger bomber with a bulbous fuselage.
